items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: Willie the Lion Smith, that is?

ctx.x: was there -- I happened to be there in town at the same time. And he sat down to the piano in the rhythm club and played. And Fats was there and Fats Waller went and got every piano player that he could find. He went and got the Lion.
Willie the Lion Smith, that is?
That's right, and he went and got James P. Johnson. He got all the pianists around there to come and listen to Art. And do you know not a one of them sat down and played behind Art Tatum.
